palisec_deployed_contracts.name: Policy registry v3 (ERC-8511)
palisec_deployed_contracts.role: Current registry: each opted-in account's active policy, loosening delay and stop state; a stop the account engaged can only be lifted by the account. ERC-165 interface 0xf594edcd.

palisec_deployed_contracts.name: Policy registry v1 (ERC-8511 first draft)
palisec_deployed_contracts.role: Superseded by v2 and v3; still readable.

palisec_deployed_contracts.name: AgentLinks
palisec_deployed_contracts.role: Links a Palisec agent to its Zolva agent on chain, so a track record is proven from both sides.
palisec_deployed_contracts.source_verification: Runtime code hash checked against the chain by verify-manifest.mjs

palisec_deployed_contracts.name: PalisecCredits
palisec_deployed_contracts.role: Sells decision credits for USDG or ETH and burns $PALISEC, visible on chain.
palisec_deployed_contracts.source_verification: Runtime code hash checked against the chain by verify-manifest.mjs

palisec_deployed_contracts_note: Palisec's own contracts are listed in palisec_deployed_contracts. Smart accounts use the canonical Safe and ERC-4337 deployments in contracts, which were already on this chain; their deployment transactions were made by third parties and are not recorded here. Each customer's smart account is a Safe proxy created by the customer's own wallet from the console.
